snippet.title: Wittle Defender | No dodging. Only domination.
snippet.description:
Welcome to Wittle Defender — a unique mix of tower defense, Roguelike, and card strategy! #wittledefender

Winning or losing is about strategy and choices, not luck! 
Your decisions dictate your fate in Wittle Defender! 
Dive into Wittle Defender & Start your adventure now!

App Store: apps.apple.com/us/app/wittle-defender/id6502815032
Google Play Store: play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.game.kingrush
